Irene: Incoming external PT report: 1 critical (metadata token leak via proxy cache), 2 mediums (wide S3 ACLs, service-role over-perm). Need a short plan for intake, retest slot, and KMS/RBAC evidence controls. Propose Aug 3 02:00-05:00 UTC. Any immediate objections?
Diego: No objections. Quick Q: do we let vendors assume a role in our acct or give cross-account read only? Prefer minimal blast-radius.
Hannah: Cross-account role into a dedicated redwood-pt account is ideal. Then we control KMS keys and bucket policies without touching prod. We'll create pt-audit-account and a pt-assessor role there.
Mikhail: Agree. We'll provision a pt-evidence-key in pt-audit-account. Key policy: allow kms:Decrypt only when Assessor session tag present and only for that key. Also suspend rotation for 48h around retest.
Irene: Good. Evidence flow: vendors upload to s3://pt-audit-evidence/{run}/ via presign-service (upload TTL 3h). After all uploads, ops snapshot CloudTrail + STS events and generate manifest.csv with sha256,size,s3path,signed_by,timestamp.
Diego: For heavy log pulls we will provide presigned downloads. For sensitive objects (db dumps or key material) we require the ephemeral cross-account role. No long-lived keys shared.
Hannah: IAM snippet for assessor-role (one-liner): allow s3:GetObject for pt-audit-evidence/*, kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:::key/pt-evidence-key, Condition: StringEquals aws:PrincipalTag/assessor:true and SourceIp in vendor ranges.
Mikhail: Also add Condition: Bool aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true for human sessions. For automation runs (vendor scanners) we can allow without MFA but restrict by session name and tag.
Irene: Audit checklist (brief): 1) CloudTrail export (all regions) 2) STS assume-role logs 3) S3 object metadata + object-lock status 4) KMS key metadata dump 5) Proxy access logs for vendor IPs.
Diego: Ops note: we'll isolate a small dedicated cluster with pinned model weights for any functional tests. Rate-limited and no DB writes. We'll announce a maintenance banner for the window.
Hannah: Retention policy: lock artifacts for 90 days using object-lock governance and tag manifest with retention expiry. We'll also store manifest in Confluence for compliance review.
Mikhail: Action items: @Mikhail create pt-evidence-key + suspend rotation, @Hannah create pt-audit-account + role and bucket, @Diego reserve cluster + presign-service hooks, @Irene coordinate NDA and retest request to vendor.
Diego: Ack. I'll open ticket INF-7201 for cluster + presign integration.
Hannah: Ack. I'll post role ARN and sample trust policy here once created.
Mikhail: Ack. Key created: alias/aws/pt-evidence-5204 (will post full ARN in ticket). Rotation hold scheduled.
Irene: Great. Once all items are posted I'll lock the Aug 3 window and publish the runbook link. Thanks team :thumbsup:
